brief: Abuaslam Tech Lab (operating as AtlabX) is a software development and fintech studio based in Zaria, Nigeria, building production-grade software and payment infrastructure for Africa. Grounded in engineering discipline: clear architecture, clean code, and systems built to last.

concepts.name: The Lab Prism
concepts.idea: An isometric hexagonal tech node embodying modular software architecture and dual A+X perspective.
rationale: Represents the 'Tech Lab' — modular software blocks, scalable APIs, and multi-dimensional system architecture.
The hexagonal footprint departs sharply from common square and circular fintech badges, giving AtlabX an ownable visual container.
Reads as an architectural portal (A) in elevation and an isometric multiplier (X) in perspective, reflecting bedrock African software infrastructure.

recommendation: The Lab Prism establishes AtlabX as an engineering-driven software and fintech studio, setting it apart from generic agencies through rigorous isometric geometry and modular system symbolism.
